# find_circ module test data

Source: [marvin-jens/find_circ/test_data](https://github.com/marvin-jens/find_circ/tree/master/test_data) (CDR1as mini set).

| File | Role |
|------|------|
| `CDR1as_locus.fa` | Small reference locus |
| `cdr1as_reads.fa` | Example reads for first-pass alignment |
| `cdr1as_reference.bed` | Expected circular splice sites (canonical run) |
| `breaking_anchors.fastq` | Extra edge-case anchors |

HEK293 full-genome fixtures (`hek_anchors.fastq.gz`, `hek_reference.bed`) are intentionally not vendored (large; need hg19).
